sources.entry: Thaw - A powerful menu bar management tool for hiding and showing menu bar items. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/stonerl/Thaw)

summary.one_liner: Thaw is a menu bar management tool for hiding and showing menu bar items, but its README only states that the repository has moved to a new location.
summary.what_it_does: The README contains only the heading "Thaw" and a notice that the repository has moved; it gives no link in the captured text and describes no features. The listing on awesome-mac describes it as a powerful menu bar management tool for hiding and showing menu bar items. Beyond that listing description, no capabilities, install steps, or platform details are documented in the README.
use_cases: hide menu bar icons on macOS
show or hide menu bar items
notable: Listed under Menu Bar Tools on awesome-mac
README is a moved-repository notice only
caveats: README is nearly empty and says the repository has moved, so the current location and documentation must be found elsewhere
No install or run instructions available in the README
License not stated in the README
